clue.text: Sound sword needed to cut wood

indicators.note: sound tells us to go by how a word is said rather than how it is written

parts.note: a sword is a blade; said in a non-rhotic accent it matches a word for cut with a toothed blade

explanation.surface: A swordsman needs a decent blade to hack through timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective (a sound, reliable sword) but signals a homophone: in British speech, without a sounded R, 'sword' and the answer are pronounced alike.
explanation.definitionFit: To saw timber is to cut it with a toothed blade, so the past tense fits 'cut wood'.

clue.text: Keep an eye on correct time

definitions.meaning: to post a lookout or guard, as sentries do
to adjust a timepiece so it shows the right hour

explanation.definitionFit: A guard posted is said to be set on duty, keeping lookout; and adjusting a wristwatch is setting it right.

clue.text: Fighting for upsetting uncooked food

indicators.note: in a down clue upsetting turns the word above it upside down, so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: uncooked food is raw
fare is food, as in 'simple fare'

explanation.surface: An argument over whether raw food is upsetting to the stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' reverses RAW to give WAR, followed by FARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Armed conflict between forces is fighting on a large scale.

clue.text: Fate of two ducks in five hundred thousand

indicators.note: the ducks are placed inside the Roman numerals for five hundred and a thousand

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
M is the Roman numeral for 1,000
a duck is a score of nought in cricket, written O, so two ducks are OO

explanation.surface: A gloomy prediction about the destiny of a pair of waterfowl among half a million.
explanation.walkthrough: 'five hundred thousand' reads as one number but is D followed by M; a cricket duck is a score of zero, shaped like O.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is one's unavoidable fate or destiny, usually a grim one.

clue.text: Suffered a nervous breakdown despite being highly praised

definitions.meaning: went to pieces mentally
acclaimed, as in 'not all it is said to be'

explanation.surface: Someone fell apart mentally even though everyone was lauding them.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack up is to collapse under strain, and something lauded is said to be built up in reputation by its praise.

clue.text: Quick diallers develop an unnatural ability

indicators.note: to develop is to change form, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: People who dial telephone numbers fast gain a strange talent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develop' rearranges the thirteen letters of QUICK DIALLERS.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned competence is not inborn, so it is an ability that did not come naturally.

clue.text: Maori food left in the cabbage patch

parts.note: kai is the Maori word for food, also used in New Zealand English

explanation.surface: A New Zealand meal is abandoned among the cabbages in the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the Scots word for cabbage or kale (a kailyard is a cabbage patch), so the definition reads loosely as what grows in the patch.
explanation.definitionFit: Kail is an old Scots spelling of kale, a leafy brassica grown in vegetable plots alongside cabbages.

clue.text: Fishing vessel with no one at the helm?

definitions.meaning: a boat that fishes with drift nets

definitions.text: with no one at the helm?
definitions.meaning: a boat nobody steers just floats along with the current

explanation.definitionFit: Herring boats using drift nets are so named, and a vessel left unsteered floats aimlessly on the tide.

clue.text: Type I convert to saintliness

indicators.note: to convert is to change something into another form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A personality type is persuaded to adopt a religious life of virtue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'convert' rearranges TYPE I.
explanation.definitionFit: Devout religious reverence is the quality of being saintly.

clue.text: Evict all the people who attended

definitions.meaning: to throw someone out of their home
the attendance figure at an event or election

explanation.definitionFit: To expel a tenant is to throw them out, and the number of voters or spectators attending is the attendance figure.

clue.text: Miscarriage of justice resulting from empiricism

definitions.meaning: read whimsically, a court hearing that goes wrong
learning by experiment and experience rather than theory

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: a court case (a trial) that ends in a mistake (an error).
explanation.definitionFit: Testing methods by experiment until one works is the empirical approach, and a botched court case is jokingly a trial gone wrong.

clue.text: Malaria cure for one out of five children in the East

parts.note: a quin is one of quintuplets, five babies born together
taken as written
E is the abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A medicine for malaria is wanted for one of a set of quintuplets living in the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one out of five children' is a single quintuplet, a QUIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Quinine, from cinchona bark, was the classic treatment against malaria fever.

clue.text: War paint War Office gets a year later

indicators.note: the year comes later, so it is placed after the War Office

parts.note: WO is the abbreviation for War Office, the former British ministry of war
AD, anno domini, marks a year of the Christian era

explanation.surface: The army ministry finally gets its camouflage supplies a year late.
explanation.walkthrough: AD (anno domini) labels a year, as in AD 1066. Ancient Britons famously painted themselves blue with this plant dye.
explanation.definitionFit: Woad is the blue plant dye ancient Britons used to daub their bodies before battle.

clue.text: A number suggesting how to start a garden plot

definitions.meaning: a single figure from 0 to 9

definitions.text: suggesting how to start a garden plot
definitions.meaning: read as an instruction to break the soil with a spade

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer as DIG IT, what you would say to begin a garden bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A numeral from nought to nine is a digit, and the phrase 'dig it' tells a gardener to turn the soil.

clue.text: Guy obtains a suspension of court proceedings

definitions.meaning: a guy is a rope steadying a tent or mast
a halt ordered by a judge

explanation.definitionFit: A rope bracing a mast is a stay, and a legal postponement ordered by a court is also a stay.

clue.text: Lawrence had an oriental sash he may have washed in India

definitions.text: he may have washed in India

parts.note: D. H. Lawrence, the English novelist, gives his initials DH
an obi is the broad sash worn with a Japanese kimono

explanation.surface: The writer Lawrence owned an Eastern sash that might have been laundered in India.
explanation.walkthrough: A dhobi is a washerman in India; 'Lawrence' gives the initials of the novelist D. H. Lawrence.
explanation.definitionFit: In India a dhobi is a laundryman who washes clothes for a living, traditionally at a river.

clue.text: Encouraged by being rottenly pelted in the market place?

definitions.meaning: urged on, as in 'urged on by the crowd'

definitions.text: rottenly pelted in the market place?
definitions.meaning: pelted with bad produce, as an offender in the stocks might be

explanation.walkthrough: 'egged on' means urged; the second sense pictures a target pelted with rotten eggs in a public square.
explanation.definitionFit: To be urged on is to be egged on, and people pilloried in public were pelted with stale eggs.

clue.text: British tank which vies for the title

definitions.meaning: a British Army main battle tank of that name
a contender taking on a reigning champion

explanation.definitionFit: The Challenger is a British main battle tank, and a contender facing a boxing champion is called the challenger.

clue.text: An environmentalist to house a navy recruit

parts.note: a Green is a campaigner for the environment
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: An ecologist is willing to give a home to a young sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' looks like a container indicator but supplies HO, and 'navy recruit' looks like one phrase but the definition is 'recruit' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A raw newcomer with no experience, such as a fresh recruit, is called a greenhorn.

clue.text: Gold bracelet represented respect for regalia

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a band can be a bracelet worn round the wrist

indicators.note: represented is read as re-presented, laid out again, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A gold bangle was offered as a mark of respect for royal emblems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' rearranges RESPECT into SCEPTRE; OR is gold in heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: The orb and sceptre are among the crown jewels a monarch holds at coronation, part of the royal regalia.

clue.text: Result of the first match on courting?

definitions.text: Result of the first match on courting?

parts.words: Result of the first match on courting?
parts.note: on a tennis court, one game won to nil is the score; for a courting couple the first match brings romantic devotion

explanation.walkthrough: 'courting' means wooing in the surface but also playing on a tennis court, where 'love' means zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis score of one game to nil is called this, and it also describes a single sweetheart.

clue.text: Extract a promise to treat one to dinner

definitions.meaning: to remove, as a dentist removes a tooth

definitions.text: a promise to treat one to dinner
definitions.meaning: the words of someone offering to take a person to a restaurant

explanation.definitionFit: To pull out or remove something is to extract it, and inviting someone to a restaurant at your expense is taking them for a meal.

clue.text: Other people write article with penultimate letter last

parts.note: the is the definite article
Y is the second-last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Others are asked to write a piece with the second-to-last letter at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last' places Y after THE; 'penultimate letter' means the alphabet's twenty-fifth letter, not a letter of any clue word.
explanation.definitionFit: The third-person plural pronoun refers to other people in general, as in 'so others say'.

clue.text: Incline to give more generous consideration

definitions.meaning: to tilt or slope
to pay up or hand over more money

explanation.definitionFit: To tilt a seat upward is to tilt it, and to hand over cash more generously is to pay up.

clue.text: Join the bandwagon and win the election

definitions.meaning: climb aboard, as onto a moving vehicle or popular cause
be voted into office

explanation.definitionFit: To climb aboard a vehicle is to board it, and a candidate voted into Parliament is elected.

clue.text: Resembling a family group

parts.note: kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: A family whose members look like each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that are related or similar in character are alike, resembling each other.

clue.text: Man's house may be opened by them

definitions.text: Man's house may be opened by them

parts.words: Man's house may be opened by them
parts.note: the lower chamber of the Isle of Man parliament shares its name with the things that unlock doors

explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, whose parliament's lower chamber is the House of Keys; a householder's door is also unlocked with them.
explanation.definitionFit: Front doors are unlocked with these, and the Manx parliament's elected chamber is the House of Keys.

clue.text: Quite satisfied with a small tankard

parts.note: a tankard is a large mug for beer

explanation.surface: A drinker is perfectly content with a modest beer mug.
explanation.definitionFit: Being self-satisfied and pleased with oneself is being complacent.

clue.text: Go-ahead chap put one in the seaside resort's main attraction

indicators.note: the word one is put inside the seaside structure

parts.note: the pier is the classic attraction of a British seaside town
taken as written

explanation.surface: An enterprising man installs something at the resort's star attraction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put ... in' signals the insertion; British seaside towns often centre on a pleasure pier jutting into the sea, its chief draw.
explanation.definitionFit: An innovator who leads the way into new territory is an early settler or go-ahead trailblazer.

clue.text: 51 mile Italian river double one in Africa

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals

indicators.note: the Italian river is to be written twice in a row

parts.note: the Po flows across northern Italy

explanation.surface: A list of rivers: a fifty-one-mile Italian waterway and its twin in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one in Africa' refers back to 'river': an African river. 'double' repeats PO.
explanation.definitionFit: The Limpopo is a river in southern Africa, flowing to the Indian Ocean through Mozambique.

clue.text: Newspapers generally incorporate certain coercive practices

indicators.note: to incorporate is to take something into the body, so one word goes inside another

parts.note: the press is newspapers collectively
sure means certain

explanation.surface: The newspaper industry tends to adopt certain bullying tactics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'generally' is only a link here; 'incorporate' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Forceful demands and intimidating persuasion are strains applied to make someone comply.

clue.text: Be promoted to board

definitions.meaning: advance in a career
climb onto a bus or train

explanation.definitionFit: To advance in a career is to progress, and to board a train is to climb aboard it.
